Class RentalServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
com.me.learning.rental.service.RentalServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
RentalService
@Service @Transactional(readOnly=true) public class RentalServiceImpl extends Object implements RentalService
Default implementation of RentalService.

Transaction strategy

  • Class-level @Transactional(readOnly = true) covers all read paths.
  • Write methods override with @Transactional (read-write).

No FK resolution required

Rental holds all cross-service references as plain ID columns (inventoryId, customerId, staffId) — there are no intra-service @ManyToOne associations to resolve, so no secondary repository lookup is needed on create or update.
